lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: New routers went in last weekend, and internet complaints came straight in.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: The Networking chapter is open. Remember the order: cable or Wi-Fi, IP address, router, internet, then DNS.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: If a whole floor drops at once, don't get stuck on one laptop. That's the network team's job.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Networks are confusing at first. Once you know the order, everything starts to make sense.
